> one thing I'm not sure about with this implementation is that it puts some complexity that's only relevant for tests in a main example. I'd rather see the same code multiple times than this factorisation (if anything needs to change we already need to do it in three flavours anyway)

I see what you mean. I tried to make it simple but I guess it's still not helpful for customers who will rely on these main examples to learn InstantSearch.js.

I'll copy the example to have a dedicated UMD implementation then.
